thread:
Ravi S: FYI CardinalCare POC is flaking on streaming responses. Their React app shows `SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input` during live demo. They see intermittent SSE disconnects. Demo in 90m, need quick triage. cc @Tanya H @Devon P

Tanya H: do we have request id / raw capture? are they using EventSource or fetch streaming?

Ravi S: req=card-poc-20260410-2. Client uses EventSource polyfill. They attached a raw capture and a hexdump. Looks like chunk split inside a multibyte emoji sequence and several `499` and `502` in access logs.

Devon P: that pattern -> runtime flush or intermediate proxy chopping bytes. Quick checklist: 1) ask them to curl -N the endpoint and provide hexdump, 2) check our runtime logs for `upstream prematurely closed connection` or worker OOM, 3) check any fronting nginx for buffering/transform.

OpsBot: Log bundle uploaded: https://s3.redwood/logs/card-poc-20260410-2.tar.gz :file_cabinet:

Tanya H: short-term demo fix: have client accumulate SSE `data:` lines until full event delimiter and parse then. Minimal handler to send them: ```let buf=''; source.onmessage = (e)=>{ buf += e.data; try{ const obj = JSON.parse(buf); /* handle */ buf=''; }catch(e){ /* wait for more chunks */ }};``` Also ask them to disable the polyfill to use native EventSource if available.

Devon P: infra notes for support: if NGINX in front, set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off; proxy_set_header Connection ""; proxy_set_header X-Accel-Buffering no;` and `Cache-Control: no-transform`. For Hosted we can also flip an org-level flag to disable streaming compression.

Ravi S: CardinalCare tried curl hexdump and it shows split inside UTF-8 emoji bytes. They reduced concurrency to 2 streams for demo and used the client accumulator. Demo passed but they want a permanent fix.

Tanya H: creating runtime ticket and marking P1. We should include a small test harness that reproduces mid-codepoint splits and verify Dedicated/Private behavior.

OpsBot: Created ticket RED-INF-5050: "sse: prevent mid-codepoint chunk flush under load" assigned to eng-runtime. Priority: P1.

Devon P: estimated mitigation: quick guard to flush only at event boundary or ensure UTF-8-safe chunking -> 48-72h behind feature flag. Full regression for Dedicated/Private ~1 week.

Ravi S: thanks team. I'll send CardinalCare the ticket link and keep them updated. Will reopen if demo regressions pop up. :white_check_mark:
